This CVE requires chroot with --userspec option, which is rarely used in container environments. The vulnerable code path cannot be reached in typical container usage patterns.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the kernel-level fix for CVE-2012-6638. While the vulnerable code exists in libxt_tcp.c, the kernel prevents exploitation of the SYN+FIN packet matching issue. Debian has marked this "unimportant" due to the kernel mitigation making this userspace issue non-exploitable.

The only viable vector for exploitation of this bug is local, if a static setuid program exists, and that program calls dlopen, then it may search LD_LIBRARY_PATH to locate the SONAME to load. No such program is present in the container image .
